about.title: Professionalism, responsiveness and quality.
text: At Ann Thomas CPA, PC, we take pride in being a local accounting firm providing quality financial guidance and personalized service to individuals and businesses throughout League City, Galveston County, Southeast Houston, and surrounding communities. Our accounting team understands that every business owner's and individual's financial situation is unique, which is why we provide tailored plans designed to help you make informed decisions and achieve long-term financial stability.

Our firm provides outstanding service to our clients because of our dedication to the three underlying principles of professionalism, responsiveness, and quality. Because we get new business from the people who know us best, client referrals have fueled our growth in the recent years.

We value relationships built on trust, accuracy, and personal attention. We work closely with you to deliver solutions that align with your goals and needs, whether you are an individual planning for the future or a small business owner looking to streamline your finances.

values.title: Professionalism
values.text: By combining our expertise, experience, and the energy of our staff, each client receives close personal and professional attention. We make sure that every client is served by the expertise of our whole firm.

values.title: Responsiveness
values.text: Companies who choose our firm rely on competent advice and fast, accurate personnel. We provide total financial services to individuals, large and small businesses, and other agencies.

values.title: Quality
values.text: Our primary goal as a trusted advisor is to be available and to provide insightful advice to enable our clients to make informed financial decisions. We feel it is extremely important to continually professionally educate ourselves to improve our technical expertise, financial knowledge and service to our clients.
